Launch facts

Big Walk Release Date and Price

Big Walk launched on August 4, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2, Steam (PC and Mac), and PlayStation 5 for $19.99 USD, with a limited-time 25% launch discount.

Release and Platforms

Release dateAugust 4, 2026
PlatformsNintendo Switch 2, Steam (PC and Mac), PlayStation 5
Price$19.99 USD
Launch discount25% off for a limited time
PlayStation PlusAvailable through the PlayStation Plus Essential tier on PS5

Nintendo's Canadian store lists the Switch 2 digital version at CAD 19.49. Price and discount timing can vary by region and store, so check the store page before buying.

Discount window: gg.deals reports the 25% launch discount on Steam and the Nintendo eShop running until August 18, 2026.

Why It Was a Big Launch

Game8 reported on August 4, 2026 that Big Walk opened with the highest Metacritic score of the year at launch: 94 on PC, tied with Sektori for the year's best at that time. The same coverage noted a massive player count at launch.
